security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around tool names, parameters, and workflow examples. The real security consideration is the intentional use of a third-party Rube MCP endpoint and Canva OAuth connection.

remediation.issue: Third-party MCP endpoint and OAuth access are required for Canva automation.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the Rube or Composio dependency clearly and tell users to review Canva OAuth permissions before connecting.

remediation.issue: Markdown backticks trigger noisy external command detections.
remediation.suggestion: Keep tool names in Markdown code style, but add a short note that examples are MCP tool calls, not shell commands.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Canva connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `canva`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
1. `CANVA_LIST_USER_DESIGNS` - List all designs with optional filters [Required]
- `query`: Search term to filter designs by name
- Results are paginated; follow `continuation` token until absent
- `asset_id`: Optional asset to include in the design
- `url`: Public URL of the file to upload (for URL-based uploads)
- `job_id`: Upload job ID returned from step 1 (for status polling)
- The `job_id` from CREATE returns the ID needed for status polling
3. `CANVA_GET_DESIGN_EXPORT_JOB_RESULT` - Poll until export completes and get download URL [Required
- `design_id`: ID of the design to export
- `job_id`: Export job ID for polling status
- `item_id`: ID of the design or asset to move
- `brand_template_id`: ID of the brand template to use
- `data`: Key-value mapping of placeholder names to replacement values
- Pass token in next request's `continuation` parameter
- Continue until `continuation` is absent or empty
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Initiate job (upload, export, autofill) -> get job_id
2. Poll status endpoint with job_id every 2-3 seconds
- Upload job must reach 'success' status before the asset_id is valid
| Move to folder | CANVA_MOVE_ITEM_TO_SPECIFIED_FOLDER | item_id, folder_id |
- File size limits apply; large files may take longer to process

content.user_title: Automate Canva Workflows with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Managing Canva designs, exports, assets, and folders manually slows content teams. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured Rube MCP workflows for Canva automation.
actual_capabilities: Lists and searches Canva designs with ownership, sorting, and pagination guidance.
Creates Canva designs from supported design types and optional uploaded assets.
Uploads assets and polls Canva upload jobs until completion.
Exports designs to supported formats and retrieves completed export links.
Creates folders and moves Canva designs or assets into target folders.
Uses brand templates for autofill workflows with placeholder data.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Canva connection before workflows can run.
Depends on current Rube tool schemas, so tools must be searched before use.
Cannot perform Canva actions that the connected account is not allowed to perform.
Async uploads, exports, and autofill jobs may need repeated status checks.

use_cases.title: Prepare Campaign Assets
use_cases.description: Find existing Canva designs, upload campaign assets, and export final files in the required format.

use_cases.title: Organize Client Workspaces
use_cases.description: Create folder structures and move Canva designs or assets into the correct client or project folders.

use_cases.title: Generate Template Variants
use_cases.description: Use brand templates and autofill data to create repeated design variants for approved campaigns.

prompt_templates.title: Find Designs
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my Canva designs for designs related to [campaign name]. Show the best matches and include ownership and modified date when available.

prompt_templates.title: Export a Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Canva design named [design name], export pages [page list] as [format], and wait until the export job completes.

prompt_templates.title: Upload and Create
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload the asset at [public asset URL] to Canva, confirm the upload succeeds, then create a new [design type] titled [title] using that asset.

prompt_templates.title: Autofill Brand Templates
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the brand template named [template name], map its placeholders to my provided campaign values, start autofill, and report the completed design result.

output_examples.input: Export the Q3 social launch design as a high quality PNG.
output_examples.output: The assistant finds the matching design, starts a PNG export, polls until completion, and returns the completed download link.

output_examples.input: Create folders for three client campaigns and move matching Canva designs into them.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates each folder, resolves each design by name, and reports which designs were moved into each folder.

output_examples.input: Generate five localized flyers from the approved brand template.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists brand templates, selects the requested template, starts autofill jobs with the supplied values, and reports each completed design.

best_practices: Search Rube tool schemas before each workflow so parameter names match the current Canva toolkit.
Confirm the Canva connection is active before creating, exporting, uploading, or moving content.
Poll async jobs until they return success or failure, then handle expired links promptly.
anti_patterns: Assuming upload, export, or autofill jobs finish immediately after creation.
Using stale design, folder, asset, or template IDs without resolving them again.
Uploading private asset URLs that the Canva service cannot reach or should not access.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Canva connection?
faq.answer: Yes. Rube MCP must be connected, and Canva OAuth must show an active connection before workflows run.

faq.question: Can it create new Canva designs?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides creation of supported Canva design types, with optional uploaded assets when available.

faq.question: Can it export designs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can start export jobs, poll for completion, and return the completed download link.

faq.question: Can it edit detailed page layouts?
faq.answer: Only when the available Canva tools support the requested action. The skill focuses on automation workflows.

faq.question: Why does it search tools first?
faq.answer: Rube tool schemas can change. Searching first helps the assistant use current parameters and response shapes.

faq.question: Is bulk automation supported?
faq.answer: Yes, but bulk work should use batching, status polling, and backoff because Canva endpoints may have rate limits.
